sol_120_wb1.name: Sol 120 WB1 (Wright Brothers Field / Octavia E. Butler Landing)

geologic_unit.name: Jezero floor unit
geologic_unit.interpretation: Volcanic ash or eolian airfall deposit that drapes underlying topography. Correlates with unit Nnp2 based on common stratigraphic position and shared textural and morphologic characteristics. Emplaced during the Late Noachian before deposition of unit NHjf1. May have been modified by subsequent lacustrine activity during deposition of units NHjf1 and NHjf2. Dark, smooth surface texture near unit NHjf2 is due to a dark mantle deposit or erosional lag derived from erosion of unit NHjf2. Previously interpreted by Schon and others (2012) and Goudge and others (2015) as an extrusive volcanic flow.
geologic_unit.description: Rugged, moderately-to-heavily cratered, light- to dark-toned, planar unit with margins defined by low-relief, sharp, lobate scarps, forms the central portion of the Jezero crater floor and overlies and embays units Nue and Nle, respectively. Most impact craters on this surface are <200 m. Can have dark, smooth surface texture, especially near contact with unit NHjf2. Type area: lat 18.43°N, long 77.65°E.
geologic_unit.additional_characteristics: Associated with mafic composition (Goudge and others, 2015). Previously mapped as the 'volcanic floor unit' by Goudge and others (2015).
geologic_unit.mission_context: Perseverance gezgininin iniş alanı (Octavia E. Butler Landing) ve Ingenuity helikopterinin ilk uçuşlarının yapıldığı Wright Brothers Field (WB1), USGS SIM 3464 haritasında Jezero floor unit (Njf) içinde yer alır. Bu birim mafik bileşimli, Geç Noaşiyen yaşlı, krater tabanını kaplayan volkanik kül veya rüzgâr çökeli olarak yorumlanmaktadır.

sol_164_roubion.name: Sol 164 Roubion (İlk Karot Örnekleme Deneme Lokasyonu)

May have been modified by subsequent lacustrine activity during deposition of units NHjf1 and NHjf2. Dark, smooth surface texture near unit NHjf2 is due to a dark mantle deposit or erosional lag derived from erosion of unit NHjf2. Previously interpreted by Schon and others (2012) and Goudge and others (2015) as an extrusive volcanic flow.

geologic_unit.mission_context: Sol 164 Roubion lokasyonu, Sol 120'nin yaklaşık 700 m güneydoğusunda aynı geniş Jezero floor unit (Njf) formasyonu içerisinde yer alır. İlk sondaj denemesinde hedeflenen ufalanabilir bazaltik/volkanoklastik kayaç dokusu, Njf biriminin tanımlanan özellikleri ile tam uyumludur.
